Sun Data Analytics is an independent analytics practice focused on clear reporting, reproducible data work, research support, and practical decision systems.

## Background

Sun Data Analytics is led by Jonathon Sun. The work sits at the intersection of analytics consulting, research reporting, data preparation, and mixed-methods interpretation.

The goal is simple: make information easier to inspect, explain, and use. That can mean a dashboard, a private report bundle, a qualitative coding workflow, an automated reporting process, a classification system, or a concise findings brief.

Recent work has focused on creator and media analytics: collecting YouTube analytics and text data, preparing private performance reports, classifying stream and video titles, coding transcript material, and building side-project scrapers for public Vtuber, anime, gacha, and media trend signals.

## Methods

:::: {.index-list}
::: {.index-item}
### Reproducible Data Work

Projects should have visible assumptions, source notes, clean intermediate outputs, stable folders, and enough documentation for someone else to understand the path from raw material to finding.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Decision-Oriented Reporting

Reports and dashboards should be readable under real constraints: clear definitions, useful comparisons, plain-language findings, and charts that serve the question.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Qualitative and Mixed-Methods Analysis

Open-ended data, transcripts, survey responses, and context notes can be structured carefully without flattening the nuance that makes them useful.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Privacy-Aware Communication

Private reports, client datasets, and source files do not need to be published for the work to be explained clearly. Public pages can describe methods, deliverable types, and workflow design while keeping sensitive results private.
:::
::::

## Contact Context

Good-fit projects usually involve messy but valuable source material, unclear reporting processes, recurring manual work, research questions that need structure, or stakeholders who need a clearer explanation of the evidence.

For questions, project fit, or collaboration, contact [jonathonsun03@gmail.com](mailto:jonathonsun03@gmail.com).
